meta.name: Rollvento AI Marketing Content System — Master Product Database
meta.sourceType: Public front-end application bundle and rendered pages of rollvento.in. All product content below is published publicly on that site.
meta.extractionMethod: rollvento.in is a client-rendered single-page application whose served HTML contains no product content. The catalogue was read from the public JavaScript bundle that drives the app, then verified against rendered product pages in a browser.
meta.deepLinkCaveat: Product URLs are valid in-app routes and are reproduced here exactly. At time of capture the host returned HTTP 404 for direct loads of nested product paths (no SPA rewrite configured), so they are not yet usable as ad landing pages.

imageStatus.REAL_PRODUCT_IMAGE: Hero image is self-hosted on rollvento.in and was verified to return an image over HTTP.
imageStatus.PLACEHOLDER: Hero image is served from a stock photo library and does not depict this product.
imageStatus.NO_IMAGE: No hero image and no gallery images are published for this product.
imageStatus.UNKNOWN: An image is referenced but its origin could not be confirmed as Rollvento product photography.

fieldDefinitions.imageSource: Where the hero image actually comes from, stated plainly, including an explicit warning when it is stock imagery.
fieldDefinitions.videoReady: True only when imageStatus is REAL_PRODUCT_IMAGE — i.e. an authentic still exists to drive image-to-video. False means text-to-video, or commission photography first.
fieldDefinitions.imageUrls: Exact image reference strings as published by the site. Relative paths are left relative; absolute forms are in imageDetail.imageUrlsAbsolute.
fieldDefinitions.notes: Array of plain-language flags: placeholder warnings, duplicate photography, sparse data, featured status.

integrityRules: No specification, rating, certification or claim was invented.
Product names are reproduced exactly as published on rollvento.in.
Product URLs are reproduced exactly as the application routes them.
Image URLs are preserved byte-for-byte as the site references them.
Stock-library imagery is never recorded as Rollvento product photography.
Model codes the site lists without published detail are recorded separately, ungenerated.
Pricing is retained for internal reference only and excluded from all marketing copy.
